coaching.headline: Murdock and Boris took eleven of thirteen duo deaths, and the allies won three fights but cashed only one into a tower.

flags.text: Murdock went 12/4/5 with the game's top 36290 hero damage, and Legion built no physical armor.
Duo lane shitshow: lost 1-4, Boris razed the duo outer, then Legion and Lt. Belica died twice more.
Boris took every Fangtooth, Mini Prime, three Seedlings and a Shaper; the allies secured no major objective.
Standout: Argus led the allies with six kills, three on Murdock and two on Boris. Damn good.

focus.title: Peel the duo, contest Fangtooth as five
focus.action: With a mage at support, Steel holds Shield Slam for Boris or Greystone diving Legion, the duo fights away from Static Traps, and Fangtooth gets all five allies.

12.3.call: Separate plays, not one fight: Boris killed Steel on the mid lane, Greystone killed Argus on the offlane and Murdock killed Legion on the duo lane, then Boris took Mini Prime. After three allied deaths across three lanes, concede Mini Prime and hold the towers.

13.9.call: Lost 1-4 on the duo lane: Murdock killed Crunch, Boris killed Legion, Maco killed Lt. Belica, Crunch killed Murdock, Boris razed the duo outer and Maco killed Crunch. Argus and Steel holding lanes was the expected play; once Crunch fell first, the duo needed to back off.

18.8.call: Won 3-0: Argus killed Boris and Murdock and Crunch killed Gadget, and Legion razed the enemy duo outer, but Gadget took the Shaper inside the same window. Once the first enemy drops in a won fight, check the Shaper pit before chasing more kills.

27.8.call: Two separate plays: Gadget killed Crunch and Greystone killed Steel on the offlane, Murdock killed Lt. Belica and Legion in the allied base, and Gadget and Boris razed two inhibitors. With inhibitors falling, the team defends as five behind Steel instead of meeting the enemy in two places.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mitigated 46971 damage, the game's most, yet died five times, three to Boris. When Boris casts Primeval Roar, back off until the barrier explodes before trading.
The third death, to Boris, came outside any detected fight, then Boris took the second Shaper. If Boris is unseen, wait for Crunch before walking the offlane.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Two early deaths to Boris came outside any detected fight, and Boris took Fangtooth after the first. Call Steel and Argus before contesting the next Fangtooth.
Three deaths went to Murdock. When Murdock shows in a fight, dive Murdock only after Steel's Shield Slam lands first.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scored the allies' last three kills, on Gadget, Murdock and Boris in the allied base. When Murdock drops low, fire Synaptic Obliterator beams at Murdock first.
Four deaths above an own average; the second, to Boris outside any detected fight, came shortly before the first enemy Fangtooth. If Boris is unseen before Fangtooth, stay beside Crunch.
ad806256-6afd-421c-979d-fcd38f542f3c: Seven deaths: four to Murdock, two to Boris. At low health, leave Murdock's ultimate line; physical armor never stops Long Arm of the Law.
Farm hit 10.9 per minute over an own 8.7, but hero damage fell to 661 per minute under an own 916. Spend that farm in fights beside Steel.
Razed the enemy duo outer, the only allied tower of the game. After the next won fight, hit the nearest standing tower again before farming.
d151f3bb-5b0a-4a89-b7d9-0ef8884ce636: Six deaths after a clean opening, four to Murdock. Against Murdock, stay off Static Traps and save Seismic Assault until Buckshot is spent.
Kill participation sat at 31 percent with seven wards against Maco's 15. Before each Fangtooth, fill Silentium's three-ward cap around the pit.

matchup: Greystone was the lane opponent, yet Boris scored three of five deaths; Greystone and Murdock took one each.
Maco healed 21538, the game's most, and Boris 19008, so frontline anti-heal had targets.
build: Fire Blossom and Tainted Guard match the most-played core into Greystone; Flux Matrix completes that 51.8% set.
Tainted Guard cuts the healing of any hero basic-attacking the wearer; Boris attacks in melee.
Sky Splitter finished last, so the Rend on-hit damage mattered only in the final fights.
eternal: Nihil leans ahead in this offlane field, and From the Abyss with Adaptive Plating is the best pair. Sound keep.
Adaptive Plating grants matching armor per hit taken, a fit for the game's most mitigated damage.
augment: Heavy Metal leans ahead in this offlane field. Sound keep.
Heavy Metal turns total physical and magical armor into bonus magical on-hit damage on Heavy Punches and Shield Bash.
crest: Saphir's Mantle narrowly leads a toss-up offlane crest field with Nyr Warboots a close contender. Sound keep.
The Resilience active regenerates max health and grants decaying movement speed, a disengage tool against Boris.
improvement: Build notes ask for anti-heal and physical armor; Tainted Guard covered both, so no change is proven there.
Fist Of Razuul over Sky Splitter completes the 62.5% offlane core.

matchup: Boris was the jungle opponent, scored ten kills including two on this jungler, and took every Fangtooth.
Ganks paid off on Gadget: three of four kills landed on Gadget, the other on Murdock.
build: Berserker's Axe is one third of the 60.8% jungle core; Augmentation and Draconum never made the build.
Forticus, finished third, brought tenacity and physical armor only for the final fights against Murdock.
eternal: The jungle Eternal field is a toss-up; Pilow leads narrowly and Nihil is a close contender. Sound keep.
Growing Threat with Terror is the best Nihil pair here; the run Adaptive Plating pairing is the most played.
augment: Combo Crunch leans ahead of Lunge Crunch in this jungle field. Sound keep.
Combo Crunch stacks attack speed whenever Cross Crunch deals damage, up to four times.
crest: Gravitum is the clear Best crest in this jungle field; Judgement trails.
Judgement's Thunder Cleaver heals on hero hits; Gravitum's Polarity Blast instead grounds the first hero hit.
improvement: Build notes flag missing anti-heal: Tainted Blade, built more into Boris than usual, cuts the target's healing on physical hits.
Salvation, the tenacity answer to Murdock, pairs with Berserker's Axe in the 54.2% winning core.

matchup: Gadget was the lane opponent and never killed this midlaner; Boris took two of four deaths.
Gadget's Security Gate roots, so sidestep the gate before committing to a trade.
build: Azure Core, Entropy and Wraith Leggings match the most-played core into Gadget, a 52% set.
Tainted Scepter, finished last, cut the healing of magical-damage targets only in the closing fights.
eternal: The midlane Eternal field is a toss-up; Lotus leads and Aion trails the close contenders.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair and the run pairing. Sound keep for the minors.
augment: Infinite Obliteration leans ahead in this midlane field. Sound keep.
Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator beams infinite range, a fit for finishing Murdock at low health.
crest: Soulbearer is the clear Best crest in this midlane field. Sound keep.
The Anima active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
improvement: Build notes ask for anti-heal, covered by Tainted Scepter; Combustion over Entropy completes the 59.4% midlane core.
Lotus over Aion is the narrow field lead, trading mana and gold from spells for random stacking stats.

matchup: The duo faced Murdock and Maco; the allied duo died once early, the enemy duo never.
Murdock's Buckshot shreds physical armor, and Long Arm of the Law ignores all physical armor.
build: Malady and Infernum are two of the 60.6% carry core; The Perforator never made the build.
Spear Of Desolation adds ultimate haste and a damage boost after each Orbital Sanction cast.
eternal: The carry Eternal field is a toss-up led by Xyris, with Lotus and Knell close; Thraex trails.
Savage Strikes with Rallying Roar is the best Thraex pair and the run pairing.
augment: Scorched Earth is the clear Best augment in this carry field. Sound keep.
Scorched Earth leaves Napalm zones from Frag Order, Saturation Charge Mines and Orbital Sanction.
crest: Witchstalker leads a toss-up carry crest field with Epoch close; Ortus trails both.
The Limit Breaker active grants movement speed and physical power, refreshed by takedowns.
improvement: Build notes ask for physical armor and anti-heal; Tainted Rounds is the carry anti-heal answer to Maco and Boris.
Equinox, the tenacity answer to Murdock, could replace Spear Of Desolation, giving up ultimate haste.

matchup: The duo faced Murdock and Maco; Murdock killed this support four times, Maco and Boris once each.
Maco finished deathless with 15 assists; no ally ever took down the enemy healer.
build: Crescelia and Dynamo are two of the 62.4% support core; Tainted Scepter never made the build.
Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take more damage briefly, pairing with Seismic Assault stuns.
eternal: The support Eternal field is a toss-up led by Lotus; Knell trails the close contenders.
Patina with Fracture is the best Knell pair and the run pairing.
augment: Combat Veteran leans ahead in this support field; Pulsefire Rounds ranks last of the three augments.
Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience; this support finished at the game's lowest level.
crest: Tranquility is the clear Best crest in this support field; Silentium trails well behind.
Tranquility's Grace heals the support and nearby heroes and adds brief damage mitigation.
improvement: Build notes flag missing anti-heal: Tainted Scepter over Timewarp, giving up cooldown speed for healing cuts.
World Breaker, the tenacity answer to Murdock, adds health and tenacity in the fourth slot.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Maco. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Maco Fly! to slow and shield himself, Maco Sparkle! from range for a longer stun, Maco Gift! to heal allies or damage enemies, then a fully charged Maco Strike!
enemyKits.winCondition: Land long-distance Sparkle! stuns and charged Strike! pushes while healing and speeding up allies with Gift!
enemyKits.passive: Mach Speed! builds movement speed while moving and grants slow immunity at full stacks, lost when hit by heroes.
enemyKits.playWith: A roaming, pick-oriented team that can follow his stuns.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Hit him to remove Mach Speed! stacks. Maco Sparkle! is slow-moving and stuns longest at range, so sidestep it or close the distance; dodge the charged Strike! line.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,210 hero damage a minute, more than 82% of Murdock carry players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Scattershot, Viper.
Murdock dealt 36,290 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +235 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Viper 8, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Lt. Belica (level 17 estimated: about 145 physical armor, 89 after penetration) and Legion (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 63 after penetration) that is about 30% and 29% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Viper (item): Against Eroded Heroes: Deal 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage.

Lesson: Murdock's penetration cut through: Lt. Belica took about 30% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 145, about 89 after 20 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Scattershot, Demolisher, Viper.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Demolisher, Viper. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 3 of the 4 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Lt. Belica, Crunch, Steel). We killed Murdock 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Murdock carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

bullets: Vermis turned every third basic attack in a row on one hero, inside a short window, into bonus max-health damage; Serration added missing-health damage on that same hit.
Hot Pursuit stacked attack speed on re-activation and reset on takedowns, so faster basic attacks filled Lightning Hawk's Momentum sooner and reached the Vermis third hit quicker.
Melting Point added bonus damage only against targets with very high physical armor, so the payoff came on heavily armored heroes, not lightly armored ones.
Xyris added damage that grew with units killed; Furor gave brief attack speed on entering hero combat; Eviscerate added damage against targets still at high health.
Furor's attack speed and Tesseract Device Canisters sped up basic attacks, and each basic attack hit set off Sky Splitter's current-health damage and Resolution's bonus.
Chrono Swipe swipes twice and applies on-hit effects, so one dash set off Sky Splitter and Resolution on every enemy in the path.
Aion gave stacking mana regeneration on casts and gold from spell damage to heroes; Runic Focus scaled magical power with current mana, which Particle Shredder blasts drain.
Bottomless Vial pays out only when Argus kills a River Buff: a potion charge back plus permanent magical power.
Dread Nova and Ether Crystal hit areas, so one cast set off Entropy on several heroes, plus Wraith Leggings' bonus on any below 40% Health.
Maco Gift's heal and Maco Fly's hero-hit shield each set off Exarch, giving the healed or shielded hero a short burst of attack speed and magical on-hit damage.
Revelation trimmed current basic ability cooldowns whenever Maco cast an ability; Fervour made basic attacks on enemy heroes heal Maco and nearby allies.
Forticus added a shield on taking hero damage, with a cooldown, plus brief bonus max health in fights; Tainted Totem cut healing on enemies Maco damaged.
